name: Triangle Subdivision for Voxelization
definition: A pre-processing step that sequentially consumes triangles to apply a subdivision scheme, aiming to create triangles that are homogeneous regarding the number of voxels generated per triangle and the compactness of their Morton index range.
summary: Triangle Subdivision for Voxelization is a pre-processing step that subdivides triangles to ensure homogeneous voxel counts and compact Morton index ranges, optimizing out-of-core batch processing.
